services.name: K9 Program
services.desc: The Stevens Police Department formed a canine unit in 2018 with its first dual-purpose canines, Luna and Fala. The program proved to be a great asset to the City. In 2019, the Stevens Point Police Department lost K9 Luna when she passed away suddenly. K9 Barry joined the team shortly thereafter and is paired with Sgt. Ballew. K9 Fala was paired with Officer Lee but retired in the Spring of 2023. K9 Coye joined the team in October 2023 and is paired with Officer Dienger.
